notes.text: Deterministic local simulator, no network/wait. COD skips authorise; ONLINE declined → zero Order/Line/Payment. Success atomically saves PLACED + snapshots + COD PENDING / ONLINE PAID, C=T (UC01-PC01–06). Any lock/write/commit failure rolls back all intended writes and releases authorization† (P2-S05/P2-S13).
Persistence: loaded/saved through data access — see 4.3.2.
